_comment: CURATED — human-edited only, never touched by scrapers. Places the OSM-derived gazetteer lacks (or lacks the Spanish name for), so the deterministic place-resolver can situate contracts that name them. Every point cites provenance: an OSM object id or an official URL. Schema: src/scraper/gazetteer-supplement.ts. Consumed by compute-tender-geo.ts and scrape-obras.ts.
